user.title: WoW Blizzard API Setup
user.description: Enter your Battle.net API credentials. You can create them at {setup_url}. If you already set up a game version, its credentials are filled in.

game_version.title: Game version
game_version.description: Each game version gets its own entry in region {region}, and the Battle.net Account its own entry for the login (gold and account collections). Entries that are already set up are not listed.

features.title: Feature Selection
features.description: Choose which features to enable for {game_version} in region {region}. You can change these later with Configure.

data.enable_character_details: Enable character details (professions, stats, talents, reputations, ...)
data.enable_region_data: Enable WoW Token price and weekly reset
data.enable_mythic_leaderboard: Mythic+ realm leaderboards and weekly affixes (about 8 MB per realm and hour)
data.enable_pvp_leaderboard: PvP leaderboard ranks of your characters (about 2 MB per bracket and hour)
data.auction_items: Item IDs for auction prices (comma separated, empty = off)

add_method.title: Characters
add_method.description: Add the first {game_version} character by hand, or log in with Battle.net to pick characters of all game versions from your account (characters of other game versions get their own entries). You can also finish now and add characters later with **Add character**. The login needs `{redirect_url}` as redirect URL of your Battle.net API client.

character.title: Add character
character.description: Select the realm and enter the name of your {game_version} character.

character_forever.title: Add WoW Forever character
character_forever.description: WoW Forever has no realms. Enter the character's first and last name, for example `Arthas Menethil`. The game mode (Normal, PvP, Role-play ...) is taken from the character.

account_login.title: Battle.net login
account_login.description: Log in with Battle.net in the window that opened.

account_select.title: Characters of your account
account_select.description: Open a game version and a realm, then tick the characters to add ({character_count} available, already configured ones are hidden). {hidden_count} characters below level 10 are not listed, the Battle.net API has no data for them.

account_failed.title: Battle.net login not completed
account_failed.description: Nothing is lost. Go back to add characters by hand or try the login again. If this keeps failing, check that `{redirect_url}` is a redirect URL of your Battle.net API client.

account_options.title: Account data
account_options.description:
{selected_count} character(s) selected. They are added to the entry of their game version, which is created if missing.

Keep the Battle.net login to load gold per character, total gold and account collections; it is stored in the **Battle.net Account** entry. Blizzard limits logins to 24 hours; afterwards the values keep their last state, everything else keeps working, and you can log in again with **Reconfigure** on the Battle.net Account entry whenever you like.

data.keep_login: Load account data (gold, account collections) while the login is valid

features.title: Configure Integration Features
features.description: Toggle the features of {game_version}. The entry reloads automatically.

data.enable_mythic_leaderboard: Mythic+ realm leaderboards & affixes (about 8 MB per realm and hour)
data.enable_pvp_leaderboard: PvP leaderboard ranks (about 2 MB per bracket and hour)
data.auction_items: Item IDs for auction prices (comma separated, empty = off)

remove_account.title: Remove Battle.net login
remove_account.description: Removes the Battle.net Account entry and with it the login, the account sensors and the gold of the characters. Characters and all other data stay. You can add the account again any time with **Add entry**.

account_login_expired.title: Battle.net login expired
account_login_expired.description: The Battle.net login of World of Warcraft has expired (Blizzard limits logins to 24 hours). Everything else keeps working; gold and account values keep their last state. To update them, open the **Battle.net Account** entry and choose **Reconfigure**. If you do not need account data, choose **Configure** there to remove the login, or ignore this notice.
